commands.review_summary:
The PR adds app-owned native Windows gateway setup, switching, lifecycle controls, cleanup, documentation, and regression coverage alongside the existing WSL setup path.

Reproducibility: yes. for the review defect: source inspection shows one startup ensure call and no later supervision trigger, while the pinned OpenClaw v2026.6.11 task has no restart-on-failure policy. Terminating the managed native gateway after tray startup should therefore leave it stopped until manual recovery.
